title: Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos DEMO
subtitle: A co-op cleaning game demo where players work together to clean messy locations and explore a weird, quirky town.
overview: Purrrifiers: Cleaning Chaos DEMO is a co-op cleaning experience available on Steam. Players team up to restore dirty environments while exploring an unusual town filled with playful interactions and mission-driven objectives. The demo focuses on the core loop: identify stains, use tools to clean them, and progress through a compact slice of the game that highlights teamwork, readability, and satisfying visual feedback.
role: I delivered the DEMO version and built the core cleaning system based on a decal-driven dirt workflow powered by shaders and compute shaders (GPU-accelerated stamping/removal and scalable stain variation). I also created and integrated VFX and post-processing to improve readability and feel (foam, bubbles, dust particles, stain highlighting, and stylized room effects). Additionally, I authored level content by placing stains across the environment, configuring their parameters, and tuning them for consistent gameplay flow and visual clarity.
description: A Steam co-op cleaning demo featuring a GPU-driven decal cleaning system, strong VFX feedback, and tuned stain placement across a full mission slice.

challenges.title: Performance-friendly cleaning at scale
challenges.description: Cleaning needed to feel responsive while staying stable under heavy stain coverage. I used a decal-based workflow supported by compute shaders to handle stamping/removal efficiently and keep the system scalable and tunable.

challenges.title: Readable dirt and satisfying feedback
challenges.description: Players must instantly understand what is dirty and what is being cleaned. I layered VFX and post-processing (foam, bubbles, dust, highlights) to increase clarity and reinforce the cleaning “feel” without overwhelming the scene.

challenges.title: Stain authoring and configuration across the level
challenges.description: Beyond the tech, the level needed coherent stain placement and consistent parameters. I placed and configured stains across the mission, iterated on visibility/intensity, and tuned setups to support natural co-op flow.

timelineCaptions: Demo foundation: first implementation of the decal cleaning workflow and early performance/readability tests.
System expansion: compute/shader iteration plus VFX and post-processing layers for cleaning feedback.
Content pass & polish: stain placement across the level, parameter tuning, and final demo stabilization.
